pages.text: **Every recipe can be replaced or removed.** Ship a recipe with the same id to replace one. Metallurgy's recipes have Fieldframe ids such as *fieldframe:alloying/metallurgy/bronze* on every edition. A recipe filter removes recipes by id, by an id prefix (a pattern ending in a star), or by family, and JEI hides them too.

KubeJS packs can do all of this from scripts too: tune and disable modules, add or replace recipes for any family, change fuels and Aura Chamber recipes, remove recipes, add chassis tiers, and veto world actions.
